description:
New hook: `use_cell(cell_ref, projection)`. Subscribes the current fiber to any cell, regardless of transport. `use_observable` becomes sugar over `use_cell` + the GenServer transport, preserving existing API.

## TDD
- Test: use_cell with a stub in-memory cell delivers initial value.
- Test: change-or-bust suppresses re-render when projection unchanged.
- Test: use_observable still works (regression).

## Files
- lib/filament/hooks.ex (add use_cell)
- test/filament/hooks/use_cell_test.exs (new)
title: Phase 2.3: Generic use_cell hook
